description: This file contains utility functions for processing voice wake trigger words and locale identifiers, used within the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: sanitizeVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of voice wake trigger words by trimming, filtering, limiting length, and providing defaults if input is empty.

methods.name: normalizeLocaleIdentifier
methods.description: Normalizes a locale identifier string by removing parts after '@', '-u-', and '-t-' delimiters.
